title: Whiteman underpaid Mildred; her departure
summary: Whiteman collected $1,500 a week from Paramount for her but paid her little, and when she asked for more she left with a reputation for being temperamental.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

Yeah.
Which I think was unfounded, because she was with Paul for a long while with no money. He paid her no money.
